faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Executive post at IIM Nagpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Executive position at IIM Nagpur is 19th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Executive role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree, with a Master's degree being preferred. Additionally, a minimum of 3 years of work experience in relevant domains is required.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the Junior Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Executive position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Executive post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Executive position will be as per the 7th Pay Commission guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Executive post at IIM Nagpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Executive role will primarily involve an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What kind of work experience is preferred for the Junior Executive role?
faq.answer: Work experience preferably in assisting Placements, Alumni affairs, Event management, Corporate communications, or related domains is preferred.

faq.question: Q9. What are the essential skills required for the Junior Executive position?
faq.answer: Essential skills include hands-on experience with the MS Office Suite and excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: The official notification and application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article, along with a link to the official IIM Nagpur website.
